# KoalaGitHub

KoalaGitHub is an open-source directory for previewing and comparing GitHub profile README visualizers. It serves a prerendered SvelteKit interface and a small Go API.

## User features

- Preview supported third-party visualizers for a supplied GitHub username.
- Copy README Markdown and reviewed GitHub Actions workflow examples.
- Sort by KoalaGitHub votes, source-repository stars, name, or date added.
- No accounts, analytics, advertising trackers, or tracking cookies.
- Pseudonymous device-based votes can be deleted from the Privacy page.

## Current registry

- Kodama bonsai tree: https://github.com/orijitghosh/kodama
- Snake and Commits: https://github.com/dahan8473/snake-and-commits
- Platane contribution snake: https://github.com/Platane/snk
- GitHub Readme Streak Stats: https://github.com/denvercoder1/github-readme-streak-stats
- GitHub Readme Activity Graph: https://github.com/ashutosh00710/github-readme-activity-graph
- Pac-Man Contribution Graph: https://github.com/abozanona/pacman-contribution-graph
- Contribution Breakout: https://github.com/cyprieng/github-breakout
- Contribution Crawl: https://github.com/MaskiCoding/Contribution-Crawl
- 3D contribution calendar: https://github.com/yoshi389111/github-profile-3d-contrib
- GitHub Profile Summary Cards: https://github.com/vn7n24fzkq/github-profile-summary-cards

## API

- `GET /api/health`: service and database health plus build version.
- `GET /api/visualizers`: registry, votes, and repository-star data. An optional UUID v4 is sent in the `X-Device-ID` header to include the current device's vote state.
- `POST /api/visualizers/{id}/vote`: toggle a vote with JSON body `{"deviceId":"<UUID v4>"}`.
- `DELETE /api/votes`: delete all votes for the UUID v4 supplied in `X-Device-ID`.

Third-party preview requests are made directly by the visitor's browser. See `/privacy` for data-processing details and `/guide` for profile README and workflow setup.
